mapping_assumptions.planar_to_circular: Preserve tower section-averaged alpha.water, calculate an equivalent liquid height, then multiply by the physical circular tower area.
mapping_assumptions.positive_flux_direction: upward from horizontal pipe into riser
mapping_assumptions.volume_derivative_proxy: d/dt of mapped total tower liquid volume using a 0.25 s cubic Savitzky-Golay derivative. It equals base liquid flux while the open top is dry.
mapping_assumptions.horizontal_depth: D times section-averaged alpha.water in each x column
mapping_assumptions.horizontal_wave_decomposition: 0.025 m resolved-profile pass, minus a 0.30 m spatial trend; envelope is 0.08 m RMS.
mapping_assumptions.active_length: largest connected interval whose residual RMS envelope is at least 2 mm; also reported at half of each frame's maximum envelope.

single_frame_velocity_cross_check.source: VTK_KH_935 export containing alpha.water and U

open_top_dryness_check.note: No velocity was exported in VTK_CASEA_HTML. A negligible top-row water fraction supports treating dV_liquid/dt as the T-junction base liquid flux.

riser_free_surface_lift.source: existing centreline probe post-processing, 0.005 s samples
